scenario.description: Maya is the keeper of her grandfather's inherited vinyl collection and is organizing a family anniversary listening night. She must make the final call about which records to play, how the turntable is configured, when the evening happens, and how the listening space is managed, with input from four relatives.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Vinyl Collection Keeper and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family has inherited a collection of about 40 vinyl records, along with the original turntable.
shared_context.S2: Maya is organizing an anniversary listening night and will decide the program, equipment setup, date, and listening arrangements.
shared_context.S3: The gathering will take place in Maya's living room, which has seating for everyone and space for the turntable.
shared_context.S4: As part of the family's usual planning, Maya goes around the room and asks each person what should shape the evening before she settles the plan.
shared_context.S5: The records include jazz, folk, soul, and several albums that belonged to Maya's grandparents.

PF1.text: Eli found a handwritten note in the collection's old sleeve box in which Grandfather requested that the listening night include exactly these six records: Kind of Blue, Blue Train, Mingus Ah Um, A Love Supreme, Time Out, and Ella and Louis; Eli has not shown the note to the group yet.

PF2.text: Samira asked audio technician Priya Nair to inspect the original turntable, and Priya recommended an AT-VM95ML cartridge plus archival inner sleeves for every record used; Samira has not passed along the recommendation.

PF3.text: Lucas promised the family he can perform a short live set only on 2026-11-14 from 19:00 to 21:00, and he has not yet told Maya about that commitment.

PF4.text: Ruth's tinnitus becomes painful above 65 dB and she needs a 10-minute quiet break after every two records; she has not mentioned this limitation to Maya.

acceptance_conditions: The program must contain exactly Grandfather's six requested records.
The original turntable must be fitted with the AT-VM95ML cartridge.
Every record used must be placed in an archival inner sleeve.
The listening night must be scheduled for 2026-11-14 from 19:00 to 21:00.
The listening plan must include Lucas's live set.
A commitment must assign Lucas the live set.
The volume must not exceed 65 dB.
The plan must include a 10-minute quiet break after every two records.
Eli's discovered note must be cited in the final justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['selected_records'] == ['Kind of Blue', 'Blue Train', 'Mingus Ah Um', 'A Love Supreme', 'Time Out', 'Ella and Louis']
content_checks.C2: 'AT-VM95ML' in decisions['turntable_setup'] or any('AT-VM95ML' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C3: 'archival inner sleeves' in decisions['record_protection'] or any('archival inner sleeves' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C4: '2026' in decisions['event_datetime'] and 'November 14' in decisions['event_datetime'] and (('7:00 PM' in decisions['event_datetime']) or ('7 PM' in decisions['event_datetime'])) and (('9:00 PM' in decisions['event_datetime']) or ('9 PM' in decisions['event_datetime']))
content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'Lucas' and 'live set' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: ('10-minute quiet break' in decisions['listening_breaks'] and 'every two records' in decisions['listening_breaks']) or any('10-minute quiet break' in c['detail'] and 'every two records' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The handwritten note changes the program from an arbitrary selection of records to exactly the six named albums and supplies the fact that must be cited.
The technician's recommendation changes the equipment choice to the AT-VM95ML cartridge and changes record handling to archival inner sleeves.
Lucas's existing promise changes the event time to exactly November 14, 2026, from 7 PM to 9 PM, and adds his live set to the program.
Ruth's tinnitus limit changes the listening plan to a maximum of exactly 65 dB and requires a 10-minute quiet break after every two records.
